info.name: Geni API
info.description:
Postman collection for the **Geni API** (geni.com, part of MyHeritage) — the World Family Tree: profiles, unions (families), ancestors, immediate family, relationship path, surnames, projects, documents, photos, videos and users. Generated from the 89 endpoints in the official reference: https://www.geni.com/platform/developer/help

**Setup**
1. Register an app at https://www.geni.com/platform/developer/apps to get an App Key (client_id) and App Secret (client_secret). Set your Site Domain; redirect_uri must be on it.
2. Fill client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri in the collection Variables.
3. Run 00 step 1 → sign in → copy code into auth_code → step 2. The token is sent as ?access_token= on every request.

Or use Postman's built-in OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code): Auth URL {{oauth_base}}/authorize, Access Token URL {{oauth_base}}/request_token, client credentials in body, then add the token as query param access_token.

**Notes**: Geni does not accept cookie authentication for the API. Object ids look like profile-g6000000012345678901 — the collection adds the 'profile-' prefix, so put only the part after it in profile_id. Writes use POST (form data or JSON). Watch X-API-Rate-Limit / X-API-Rate-Remaining / X-API-Rate-Window headers.
